ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_tanh_rank_advantage_weighted_fixed
ir.intuition: Uses advantage difference for ranking and weighting, ensuring differentiability by reading log_prob_w and log_prob_l to preserve the computational graph.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l
norm_rank = rank_gap(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)
bounded_adv = tanh(adv_diff)
weight_factor = 1 - norm_rank
loss_raw = - bounded_adv * weight_factor
weighted_loss = loss_raw * weight
return mean(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    adv_diff = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)
    norm_rank = ops.rank_gap(lpw, lpl)
    bounded_adv = ops.tanh(adv_diff)
    weight_factor = ops.sub(1.0, norm_rank)
    loss_raw = ops.neg(ops.mul(bounded_adv, weight_factor))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_raw, weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
